basic_info.description: Easy to show by appointment! Bright, Serene Top-Floor Condominium! Tucked away at the rear of the building, this sun-drenched top-floor residence offers rare tranquility. With no street or neighborhood noise, it's your quiet escape, windows open year-round. The spacious open-plan living / dining area features soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and direct access to a private balcony with iconic views and an unique neighborhood mural. With the Mission's renowned sunshine, it's the perfect spot. The modern kitchen includes a breakfast bar, top-of-the-line appliances and sleek quartz countertops. The flexible floor plan offers 2 beds and 2 baths, including an expansive primary suite, plus ample storage throughout. A deeded EV-ready garage parking spot is included as well as secure bike parking and a deeded storage. HOA dues include fiber optic internet, Water & hot water, professional management and well-funded reserves and proactive maintenance that protect your investment. Savvy buyers recognize this as a sign of no unexpected costs nor surprise special assessments down the road. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry and multiple skylights in a pet friendly building. Come see why this Mission gem stands out. Thoughtfully updated, peacefully situated, and priced to move.
